productBrief:
Feature: Field Service Dispatch — Product Requirements Document
Dana's HVAC shop operates a 15-technician field service team whose dispatch workflow today relies on a shared whiteboard and group text threads. This creates coordination failures: unclear assignment ownership, no audit trail for disputes, no systematic SLA visibility, and no structured workload view for the owner. The tool must replace that informal system without the complexity or cost of enterprise platforms like Salesforce. The proposed solution is a lightweight, role-aware web application backed by a FastAPI REST service and a Streamlit dispatcher board.
